decisions.reason: Because this 2023 offer disappeared from the website by 2024 and is less central to the firm's announced digital water-infrastructure strategy, the remaining public commitment is too weak to justify continued escalation.
As a web tool that was no longer promoted in 2024, it likely carries relatively low sunk cost and low visible commitment, making it the easiest product to discontinue.
Its removal from the website after the launch year suggests the firm has already begun to de-escalate, and it is less strategically central than broader control and energy-management solutions.

This 2024 launch is close to the firm's core hydraulic infrastructure business, so recent engineering investment and the ability to blame slow adoption on long public procurement cycles support persistence.

The energy management system fits directly with the firm's stated direction toward digitally networked, efficient and energy-aware infrastructure, so sunk R&D, strategic commitment and future justification strongly favor continuing it.

A dedicated product page indicates visible public commitment, and as a recent launch in core water-level regulation the firm is likely to keep backing it while attributing any weak early results to temporary market timing.
